entities.summary: Ibrahim Mahama is a Ghanaian businessman and founder of Engineers and Planners, a West African indigenously owned mining company. He owns other businesses in Ghana, including Dzata Cement Limited. He is the younger brother of the current President of Ghana John Dramani Mahama.
